pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are characterized by irregular polygonal geometry with smooth, non-angular pixel gradients at the edges. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the base of the neck and shoulder, reducing in size and increasing in fragmentation towards the posterior and ventral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative-space pathways form a continuous interconnected graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank, maintaining clear separation between dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette. The 1D contour consists of fine, repeating serrations against the background sky.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, large bulbous protrusion or swelling is located on the ventral-anterior aspect of the lower neck/brisket. This mass exhibits textural disruption and lacks the standard patch pattern of the surrounding area.
